answer: Prayers & Duties >> Death & Funeral Question ID: 13370 Country: India Title: One of my friends mother expired. whether he can recite quran, give food to poor and do good deeds and send the sawab of above acts to her dead mother. please clarify and quote the relevant hadees. Question: One of my friends mother expired. whether he can recite quran, give food to poor and do good deeds and send the sawab of above acts to her dead mother. please clarify and quote the relevant hadees. Answer ID: 13370 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 862/862=M/1430) Your friend can recite the Quran for the isal-e-thawab of his mother. He can also feed the poor and can deliver the reward through other means of good deeds. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
